status: technical feasibility amendment after v7 stopped on VP23 missing daytime; Binder outcomes were computed but not used to choose this handling; all learner grids unchanged
anchor: fixed original uHNDI, training median/IQR asinh; raw T retained as fixed strong baseline
kernel: training-scaled Gaussian marginal kernel and unscaled Gaussian matrix-log joint kernel, widths from positive training median distances; mixture weight selected in inner CV
score: anchor + eta*tanh(K beta); pairwise logistic objective with RKHS ridge, same objective for all cohorts
selection: mean inner-fold AUC, ties within 1e-12 prefer eta=0 then smaller eta, larger ridge and listed joint weight
primary_metric: mean outer-fold AUC, equal-weight macro cohort average; all seeds, raw scores, and adverse outcomes reported
performance_target: positive macro delta over both strong baselines at every seed and positive mean cohort deltas over both; gains must be attributable beyond pure anchor

binder.joint: trace-normalized spatial second moments per context/band, matrix logarithm; no connectivity claim

wielek.marginal: context occupancy and signed night-minus-day contrasts, proportions rather than counts
wielek.joint: continuous same-record adjacent one-hot pairs within each context; no edges across recording/time gaps
wielek.missing_context: Emit NaN for unavailable daytime occupancy/joint descriptors and night-minus-day contrasts. Median imputation independently refit in every training fold, no exclusion or missingness indicator. No fabricated daytime observation.

mendeley.context_rule: elapsed recording block position, not accepted-block index
mendeley.marginal: normalized diagonal band powers, logarithm after fixed trace ridge
mendeley.joint: Hermitian cross-spectra mapped to 12x12 real SPD matrices, trace normalization plus ridge and matrix log
mendeley.source_check: recompute raw EDF hashes, match all41 nominal theta/alpha and QC count to historical store

fairness: all multifeature methods receive the same target, original score, marginal and joint vectors; all preprocessing/model/parameter choices confined to training folds; no excluded subjects or label inversions
history: earlier studies and manuscripts byte-protected; isolated results/context_kernel_v7; preserve every unfavorable result
novelty_scope: candidate context-conditioned representation plus anchored multikernel learning; existing kernels/SPD tools are not claimed as original inventions
